// FAQ grouped by topic: billing, payments, account and security. A topic list (tabs; the arrow keys move // between topics) sits beside a card with the chosen topic's questions in an accordion. On phones the // topics become a grid of buttons above the card. import { type LucideIcon, Receipt, ShieldCheck, UserRound, Wallet } from "lucide-react" import { Accordion, AccordionContent, AccordionItem, AccordionTrigger } from "@/components/ui/accordion" import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs" const TOPICS: { id: string; label: string; icon: LucideIcon; body: string; faqs: [string, string][] }[] = [ { id: "billing", label: "Billing", icon: Receipt, body: "Your plan, when we charge you and changing what you pay.", faqs: [ ["When will I be charged?", "On the day your trial ends, then on the same date each month or year. We email you three days before every charge."], ["Can I switch between monthly and yearly?", "Yes, from Settings. Moving to yearly takes effect straight away and we credit what is left of the month."], ["Do you give refunds?", "If you forget to cancel a yearly plan, write to us within 14 days of the renewal and we refund it in full."], ["Do I get invoices for my own books?", "Every charge comes with a PDF invoice showing your company details and tax number. They all live under Settings, Billing."], ], }, { id: "payments", label: "Payments", icon: Wallet, body: "How your clients pay you and when the money arrives.", faqs: [ ["Which payment methods can my clients use?", "Card, Apple Pay, Google Pay and bank transfer. Turn each one on or off for every invoice."], ["What are the fees?", "Cards cost 2.9% + 30¢ and bank transfers 0.8%, capped at $5. There is no monthly fee for taking payments."], ["When does the money reach my bank?", "Card payments land in two working days. Bank transfers arrive as soon as your client's bank sends them."], ["Can a client pay in parts?", "Yes. Turn on payment plans and a client can split an invoice into up to four payments. Orbit chases each one."], ], }, { id: "account", label: "Account", icon: UserRound, body: "Your team, your accountant and the businesses you run.", faqs: [ ["Can I add someone from my team?", "Studio includes two seats and Agency five. Each person signs in with their own email and sees only what their role allows."], ["Can my accountant see my invoices?", "Invite them for free as a read-only member. They can export everything but can't send or change anything."], ["Can I run two businesses from one account?", "On Agency, yes. Each brand keeps its own logo, invoice numbers and bank details."], ["How do I close my account?", "From Settings. Export your data first: we delete everything 30 days after you close the account."], ], }, { id: "security", label: "Security", icon: ShieldCheck, body: "Where your data lives and who can see it.", faqs: [ ["Where is my data stored?", "In data centers in the EU or the US, encrypted in transit and at rest. You pick the region when you sign up."], ["Do you support two-step sign-in?", "Yes, with an authenticator app or a passkey. Agency owners can make it required for everyone."], ["Who at Orbit can see my invoices?", "Nobody, unless you ask support to look at something. Every access is logged, and you can read the log in Settings."], ["What if someone signs in from a new device?", "We email you straight away with the device and where it is, and one click signs it out."], ], }, ] export default function FaqCategories() { return (
